description: Implement core token contracts (CafeToken + CoffeeCacaoSwapFactory) with governance features and Coffee/Cacao certification verification. CafeToken is ERC20Votes with 100M fixed supply, minting restricted to MasterChef. Factory uses CREATE2 for deterministic pool deployment and integrates with AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability.isBatchCertified(bytes32 batchId, bool isCoffee) for Coffee/Cacao token whitelisting ONLY.
steps: Implement CafeToken.sol: ERC20 + ERC20Votes + ERC20Permit from OpenZeppelin 5.6.1, 100M MAX_SUPPLY constant, mint() restricted to masterChef address via AccessControl MINTER_ROLE, custom errors, 18 decimals

Implement CoffeeCacaoSwapFactory.sol: mapping(address => bytes32) tokenToBatchId, mapping(address => bool) coffeeTokens, mapping(address => bool) cacaoTokens, mapping(address => mapping(address => address)) getPair, enum TokenType { COFFEE, CACAO }, addCertifiedCoffeeToken(address token, bytes32 batchId) onlyOwner calls AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability(traceabilityContract).isBatchCertified(batchId, true) before whitelisting, addCertifiedCacaoToken(address token, bytes32 batchId) onlyOwner calls isBatchCertified(batchId, false), createPool(tokenA, tokenB) checks (coffeeTokens[tokenA] || cacaoTokens[tokenA]) && (coffeeTokens[tokenB] || cacaoTokens[tokenB]) - ONLY Coffee/Cacao allowed, uses CREATE2 with salt = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(token0, token1)) where token0 < token1

Write blockchain/tests/CafeToken.test.js: test mint with supply cap, transfer updates voting power, delegation works, getVotes at past block returns snapshot, permit signature verification, revert when non-minter calls mint

Write blockchain/tests/CoffeeCacaoSwapFactory.test.js: test addCertifiedCoffeeToken verifies Coffee batch certification, addCertifiedCacaoToken verifies Cacao batch certification, createPool accepts Coffee/Coffee pairs, createPool accepts Coffee/Cacao pairs, createPool accepts Cacao/Cacao pairs, createPool reverts for non-Coffee/Cacao tokens, CREATE2 produces deterministic addresses, getPair returns correct pool address, duplicate pool creation reverts
Commit: 'feat: implement CafeToken and CoffeeCacaoSwapFactory with Coffee/Cacao certification verification'
acceptance_criteria: CafeToken implements ERC20Votes with voting power equal to balance and delegation support
CafeToken enforces 100M supply cap and only allows MasterChef to mint
Factory addCertifiedCoffeeToken() calls AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability.isBatchCertified(batchId, true) and reverts if invalid
Factory addCertifiedCacaoToken() calls AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability.isBatchCertified(batchId, false) and reverts if invalid
Factory createPool() reverts when either token is NOT Coffee or Cacao certified
Factory createPool() accepts Coffee/Coffee, Coffee/Cacao, and Cacao/Cacao pairs ONLY
CREATE2 deployment produces identical pool addresses for same Coffee/Cacao token pairs
All unit tests pass: npx hardhat test blockchain/tests/CafeToken.test.js blockchain/tests/CoffeeCacaoSwapFactory.test.js
verification: npm run blockchain:compile completes without errors
npx hardhat test blockchain/tests/CafeToken.test.js --network hardhatMainnet passes all tests
npx hardhat test blockchain/tests/CoffeeCacaoSwapFactory.test.js --network hardhatMainnet passes all tests
